description: Plan 28 Phase 4: six location infestations and four shelter infestations. Effects route through owning systems via host callbacks (inventory food loss, Plan 09 disease port, ventilation wear); every infestation names grounded clear options and, where sensible, a bounded tolerated-harvest alternative. Rebuilt from the retired-content contract in docs/ecology/RETIRED_ECOLOGY_ISLAND.md.

infestations.name: Subway Ballast Molerat Burrow Complex
infestations.trigger_summary: Ballast spoil heaps under the depot have gone honeycombed with molerat runs.
infestations.hazard_summary: Collapsed footing over burrow mouths; females defend the nest gallery.
infestations.leave_benefit_summary: A molerat larder: hoarded tubers and cached rations can be lifted while the colony is left in place.

clear_options.outcome_summary: Smoked out from three vents; the tunnels stand empty.

clear_options.display_name: Run a trap line along the spoil heaps
clear_options.outcome_summary: The trap line thinned the burrow over two visits; the ground is quiet.

infestations.name: Limestone Quarry Slag Hornet Swarm
infestations.trigger_summary: A papery hive the size of a barrel hangs under the quarry lip.
infestations.hazard_summary: Slag hornets defend a wide arc; stings seep and fester.

clear_options.outcome_summary: The hive drops silent; the comb comes away in slabs.

clear_options.display_name: Burn the hive face at dusk
clear_options.outcome_summary: The hive burns down to the anchor; the comb is ruined for harvest.

infestations.leave_benefit_summary: Hive resin dressed on scrap cloth seals wounds; a working medkit's worth, if you can stand the edge of the swarm.

infestations.name: Presshouse Cellar Black Rot Bloom
infestations.trigger_summary: The thaw found the cellar: black rot sheets across the press beams and breathes spores into the dark.
infestations.hazard_summary: Spore load in the cellar air; unprotected lungs settle it deep.
infestations.leave_benefit_summary: Cut and dried, the rot fruits into insulation bricks — if you work the damp dark with a mask on.

clear_options.display_name: Fog the cellar and scrub the timbers
clear_options.outcome_summary: The cellar burns white with fog, then the rot lifts off in sheets.

infestations.name: Ordnance Depot Armored Roach Cluster
infestations.trigger_summary: The depot's warm dark corners have gone to roaches; crate linings rustle.
infestations.hazard_summary: Contaminated casings underfoot; the colony chews gasket and cordite wrap.
infestations.leave_benefit_summary: Desperate protein, roasted hard. Nobody puts it on the ledger twice.

clear_options.display_name: Mesh-isolate the crate stack and starve the colony
clear_options.outcome_summary: Mesh and tin close the run; the cluster thins out over the week.

infestations.name: Seven Span Bridge Slime Rot
infestations.trigger_summary: Damp season found the bridge pilings: a slime-rot carpet spreading over the tow-path boards.
infestations.hazard_summary: Slip-risk on every span; spore haze in still air.
infestations.leave_benefit_summary: Pressed and dried, the carpet's mats render into bio-plastic stock.

clear_options.display_name: Wash the spans with lime slurry
clear_options.outcome_summary: The carpet blisters and lifts off the stone.

infestations.name: Printworks Paper-Nest Rat King
infestations.trigger_summary: Cold drove the paper-nest rats together under the press floor; the colony runs a heap of shredded archive.
infestations.hazard_summary: Gnawed cables, fouled stock, and a boldness that comes of numbers.

clear_options.outcome_summary: The nest is pulled apart and burned; the hoard comes up with it.

clear_options.display_name: Set a trap line along the press floor
clear_options.outcome_summary: Trap line thins the nest over the week; the floor goes quiet.

infestations.leave_benefit_summary: The rats hoarded what the mill dropped: a sealed canister of stove fuel, unspoiled.

infestations.name: Filtration Stack Intake Spore Incursion
infestations.trigger_summary: Damp days have taken the intake stack: a gray mold felt is creeping over the filter housing.
infestations.hazard_summary: Filtration efficiency sags; spores ride the intake while the bloom runs.

clear_options.display_name: Swap the intake filter for a sealed HEPA
clear_options.outcome_summary: Fresh filter seated, intake wiped with solvent; the bloom has nowhere to feed.

clear_options.display_name: Solvent-wash the stack and dry it hard
clear_options.outcome_summary: Solvent, scrub, and a day of hard drying — the bloom lifts.

infestations.name: Shelter Commissary Granary Weevil Bloom
infestations.trigger_summary: Grain sacks in the commissary have gone soft and moving: weevils rode in on the last trade.
infestations.hazard_summary: Bounded stock loss per day until the sacks are repacked or spent.
infestations.leave_benefit_summary: Sifted and toasted, the weevil-heavy grain stretches one more week. Nobody thanks the cook.

clear_options.display_name: Repack dry stores with preservation salt
clear_options.outcome_summary: Salt-repacked and re-binned; the bloom starves.

clear_options.display_name: Break the commissary down and air the stock
clear_options.outcome_summary: A day of hauling and stacking; the bloom loses its warm dark.

infestations.name: Bunk Timber Rodent Nest
infestations.trigger_summary: Warm walls and a loose panel: rats have drawn cloth and paper into the bunk framing.
infestations.hazard_summary: Chewed wiring, fouled bedding, noise at every hour.

clear_options.display_name: Drive them out with a charcoal smolder and board the gap
clear_options.outcome_summary: The nest bolts for the corridor; the panel screws down tight after.

clear_options.display_name: Strip the panel, clear the nest, board it square
clear_options.outcome_summary: Stripped, cleared, and boarded; the wall is a wall again.

infestations.name: Hydroponic Tray Cutworm Outbreak
infestations.trigger_summary: Cutworms rode in on traded seed stock; the trays show clipped stems at the soil line by morning.
infestations.hazard_summary: Standing crop loss until the worms are picked or the trays are treated.

clear_options.outcome_summary: A long night with a lamp and a jar; the trays are clean.

clear_options.display_name: Wash trays down with dilute solvent
clear_options.outcome_summary: Solvent wash and a rinse; the trays hold, the worm doesn't.

notes: Six location infestations (subway molerat burrow, quarry hornet swarm, cider-press cellar rot, ordnance roach cluster, bridge fungal carpet, printworks rat king) and four shelter crises (vent mold, pantry weevils, wall nest, tray cutworm). Clear costs use live item ids; leave-options give three infestations a bounded non-combat path; shelter food loss is capped by EcologicalInfestationSystem.MaxFoodLossPerDay; mold blooms seed spore disease only through the Plan 09 disease port.
